technique_name: Describe the impact of social media on our daily lives.
description: Social media has had a significant impact on our daily lives, with platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and Snapchat shaping the way we communicate, consume news, and interact with each other. In particular, social media has enabled us to connect with others in different parts of the world, create and share content, and receive real-time updates on events happening all over the world.
